chunks: From him, from Ibn Faddal, from more than one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The jarri, the marmahi, and the tafi are forbidden in the book of Ali (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الطَّافِيِّ: A specific type of fish, often identified as a type of carp or similar fish.
key_terms.الْجَرِيِّ: A specific type of fish, often identified as a type of carp or similar freshwater fish.
key_terms.الْمَارْمَاهِيِّ: A specific type of fish, often identified as a type of sturgeon or similar fish.
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The book of Imam Ali, referring to a collection of his rulings or a specific text attributed to him.

ai.seo_question: Which types of fish are considered haram in Shia jurisprudence according to the book of Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Istibsar* establishes the prohibition of consuming three specific fish species—*al-jarri*, *al-marmahi*, and *al-tafi*—based on a ruling attributed to Imam Ali (AS). It highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of relying on the *Kitab* (written record) of the Imams for dietary laws, distinguishing these specific types from the general permissibility of other seafood.
